text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Foreign Affairs and Cooperation Minister Leonardo Simao has called on France's private sector to invest in Mozambique. Simao was speaking in Maputo at the opening of a meeting of the Franco-Mozambican Joint Commission for Cooperation, attended by French Cooperation Minister Charles Josselin.
- A Mozambican border post at Phuza in Matutuine district is a favoured route for drug smugglers, car thieves and gun runners working across the frontier with South Africa's KwaZulu-Natal province.
